exposure: Women without a previous uterine scar
Women with a previous uterine scar
cohort: 250 pregnant women undergoing termination of pregnancy
finding: The use of vaginal misoprostol for termination of pregnancy in women with a previous Cesarean scar was not contraindicated and was effective, although it resulted in a lower rate of complete abortions compared to women without a scar.
mod_finding: The use of misoprostol for termination of pregnancy in women with prior cesarean scars was not contraindicated.
